hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler lending vaults using a custom bonding curve. In `beforeSwap`, it computes quotes, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, and withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, returning a `BeforeSwapDelta` to bypass standard pool math. Each pool instance is a minimal delegatecall proxy to the EulerSwap implementation.
